examples.ko: 민수 씨가 공원에 가자고 했어요. 그 제안에 아직 대답하지 않았어요.
examples.en: Minsu suggested going to the park. I haven't answered his suggestion yet.
The team leader accepted my proposal.
That's a good suggestion. I'll think about it.
On my friend's suggestion, we started exercising together.
I turned down that offer.

explain: '제안'은 회사나 회의에서 자주 써요. 친구에게 가볍게 말할 때는 '같이 가자'처럼 '-자'로 말해요.

dict_examples.ko: 함께 일을 해 보자는 제안에 응하기로 했다.
dict_examples.en: I decided to accept the proposal to work together.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 순수한 학문적 목적만으로 독서회를 하자는 제안에 반대하는 학생은 하나도 없었다.
dict_examples.en: Not a single student opposed the proposal to hold a reading group for purely academic purposes.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역
국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 제안 is common at work and in meetings. With a friend you just suggest casually with -자, like '같이 가자'.

en: to decide, to fix (a time or place)

examples.en: We set the meeting time for one o'clock.

examples.ko: 여행 갈 곳을 아직 못 정했어요.
examples.en: We still haven't decided where to go on our trip.

examples.ko: 우리 모임 이름을 같이 정해 봐요.
examples.en: Let's decide on our group's name together.

examples.ko: 점심 메뉴를 정하는 게 제일 어려워요.
examples.en: Choosing the lunch menu is the hardest part.

examples.ko: 규칙을 먼저 정하고 나서 게임을 시작했어요.
examples.en: We set the rules first and then started the game.

explain: '정하다'는 일상에서, '결정하다'는 회의나 서류에서 더 많이 써요. 시간, 장소, 메뉴처럼 고르는 일에 잘 어울리고, 이미 결정된 것은 '정해지다'라고 해요.
explain_en: '정하다' is used in daily life, while '결정하다' is more common in meetings or documents. It goes well with choosing a time, place or menu, and something already decided is described with '정해지다'.

dis.h: everyday word for choosing or fixing something

p.n: 결정하다 sounds more formal and serious.

en: to agree with, to be in favour of

examples.en: Everyone agreed with Rena's suggestion.
I'm in favor of that plan.

examples.ko: 회의에서 직원 대부분이 새 규칙에 찬성했어요.
examples.en: Most employees at the meeting agreed with the new rule.
Please raise your hand if you're in favour.
My older brother was in favour of moving, but I was against it.

explain: '~에 찬성하다'처럼 조사 '에'를 써요. '~를 찬성하다'라고 하지 않아요. 반대말은 '반대하다'예요.
explain_en: Use the particle 에: '~에 찬성하다'. You don't say '~를 찬성하다'. The opposite is 반대하다.

examples.en: Minsu is active in a hiking club.
I joined a cycling club, and we ride every weekend.

examples.ko: 저는 일요일마다 축구 동호회에서 공을 차요.
examples.en: Every Sunday I play football at my football club.
I became friends with the people I met at the hobby club.

examples.ko: 독서 동호회 모임은 한 달에 한 번이에요.
examples.en: The book club meets once a month.

explain: '동호'는 '같은 것을 좋아하는 것'이라는 뜻이에요. 그래서 '사진 동호회'처럼 취미 이름을 앞에 붙여요.

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역
국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 동호 means 'liking the same thing'. That's why the hobby comes first: 사진 동호회 (photo club).

examples.en: I joined a photography club in college.
The older club members welcomed the freshmen.
I joined a film club at university.
I practised guitar with friends in the club room.
I'm busy even on weekends because of club activities.

explain: 학교 안의 모임은 '동아리', 학교 밖에서 어른들이 취미로 모이는 모임은 '동호회'라고 해요.

dict_examples.en: A federation of university student clubs.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: A group inside a school is a 동아리; a hobby group of adults outside school is a 동호회.

examples.en: I met a high school classmate for the first time in ages.

examples.ko: 결혼식에서 초등학교 동창을 십 년 만에 봤어요.
examples.en: At the wedding I saw an elementary school classmate for the first time in ten years.

examples.ko: 동창 중에 지금 외국에 사는 친구가 있어요.
examples.en: One of my schoolmates lives abroad now.
A university alumnus joined our company.

examples.ko: 동창이 새로 가게를 열어서 축하해 주러 갔어요.
examples.en: A schoolmate opened a new shop, so I went to congratulate them.

explain: '동창'은 학교 이름 뒤에 붙여 말해요. 초등학교 동창, 대학 동창처럼요. 한 사람을 말할 때 '동창생'이라고도 해요.
explain_en: 동창 is usually placed after the school: 초등학교 동창, 대학 동창. For one person you can also say 동창생.

examples.en: There's a college reunion next month.
At reunions we talk a lot about the old days.
The alumni reunion fee is 20,000 won.
Are you coming to the reunion? — Yes, I'll be there.

examples.ko: 일이 바빠서 이번 동창회에 못 갔어요.
examples.en: I was busy with work and couldn't go to the reunion this time.

explain: '회'는 모임이라는 뜻이에요. 동창회, 설명회, 발표회처럼 '-회'로 끝나는 말이 많아요.
explain_en: 회 means a gathering. Many words end in -회, such as 동창회, 설명회 (briefing) and 발표회 (presentation event).

examples.en: We have a team dinner tonight.
At the team dinner, the department head sang a song.
We chose a Korean BBQ restaurant for the company dinner.

examples.ko: 회식 때문에 오늘은 집에 늦게 가요.
examples.en: Because of the company dinner, I'll get home late today.
At the company dinner, I talked a lot with my teammates.

explain: '회식'은 회사 사람들과 하는 식사에만 써요. 친구나 가족 모임에는 '모임'이나 '저녁 식사'를 써요.

dict_examples.en: Our department has a team dinner once a month to build friendship.

dict_examples.ko: 저녁은 오늘 친구들과 회식을 하기로 하였으니까 곧 가 봐야 하겠어요.
dict_examples.en: I've decided to have dinner with friends tonight, so I need to go soon.

explain_en: 회식 is only for meals with colleagues. For friends or family, say 모임 or 저녁 식사.
